verses.text: A Song of Ascents. Remember, O LORD, on David's behalf, All his affliction;
verses.textZh: （上行之詩。）耶和華啊，求你記念大衛所受的一切苦難！

verses.text: How he swore to the LORD And vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob,
verses.textZh: 他怎樣向耶和華起誓，向雅各的大能者許願，

verses.text: 'Surely I will not enter my house, Nor lie on my bed;
verses.textZh: 說：我必不進我的帳幕，也不上我的床榻；

verses.text: I will not give sleep to my eyes Or slumber to my eyelids,
verses.textZh: 我不容我的眼睛睡覺，也不容我的眼目打盹；

verses.text: Until I find a place for the LORD, A dwelling place for the Mighty One of Jacob.'
verses.textZh: 直等我為耶和華尋得所在，為雅各的大能者尋得居所。

verses.text: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah, We found it in the field of Jaar.
verses.textZh: 我們聽說約櫃在以法他，我們在基列耶琳就尋見了。

verses.text: Let us go into His dwelling place; Let us worship at His footstool.
verses.textZh: 我們要進他的居所，在他腳凳前下拜。

verses.text: Arise, O LORD, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，求你興起，和你有能力的約櫃同入安息之所！

verses.text: Let Your priests be clothed with righteousness, And let Your godly ones sing for joy.
verses.textZh: 願你的祭司披上公義！願你的聖民歡呼！

verses.text: For the sake of David Your servant, Do not turn away the face of Your anointed.
verses.textZh: 求你因你僕人大衛的緣故，不要厭棄你的受膏者！

verses.text: The LORD has sworn to David A truth from which He will not turn back: 'Of the fruit of your body I will set upon your throne.
verses.textZh: 耶和華向大衛、憑誠實起了誓，必不反覆，說：我要使你所生的坐在你的寶座上。

verses.text: 'If your sons will keep My covenant And My testimony which I will teach them, Their sons also shall sit upon your throne forever.'
verses.textZh: 你的眾子若守我的約和我所教訓他們的法度，他們的子孫必永遠坐在你的寶座上。

verses.text: For the LORD has chosen Zion; He has desired it for His habitation.
verses.textZh: 因為耶和華揀選了錫安，願意當作自己的居所，

verses.text: 'This is My resting place forever; Here I will dwell, for I have desired it.
verses.textZh: 說：這是我永遠安息之所；我要住在這裡，因為是我所願意的。

verses.text: 'I will abundantly bless her provision; I will satisfy her needy with bread.
verses.textZh: 我要使其中的糧食豐滿，使其中的窮人飽足。

verses.text: 'Her priests also I will clothe with salvation, And her godly ones will sing aloud for joy.
verses.textZh: 我要使祭司披上救恩，聖民大聲歡呼！

verses.text: 'There I will cause the horn of David to spring forth; I have prepared a lamp for Mine anointed.
verses.textZh: 我要叫大衛的角在那裡發生；我為我的受膏者預備明燈。

verses.text: 'His enemies I will clothe with shame, But upon himself his crown shall shine.'
verses.textZh: 我要使他的仇敵披上羞恥；但他的冠冕要在頭上發光。
